pages.title: Item Supply Game
pages.text: Item Supply is exactly as the name sounds, collecting 10 of each displayed item. Clicking the orange labyrinth block downstairs begins the game and displays the items needed. Inputting 10 of each item allows you to use the block upstairs.

pages.title: Webbed Idol
pages.text: The Webbed Idol being used on the block upstairs, after a win, provides the Advanced Ambition Map.

pages.title: Conductive Bar
pages.text: The Conductive Bar being used on the block upstairs, after a win, provides the Advanced Anticipation Map.

pages.title: Frosted Log
pages.text: The Webbed Idol being used on the block upstairs, after a win, provides the Advanced Resolve Map.

pages.title: Relic of Infinite Mirages
pages.text: The Relic of Infinite Mirages being used on the block upstairs, after a win, provides the Advanced Perception Map.

pages.title: Jar of Blood
pages.text: The Jar of Blood being used on the block upstairs, after a win, provides the Advanced Cruelty Map.
